name: url-shortener
description: A modern URL shortener with custom domains

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "AUTH,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta.bold,blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --workspace=auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
